program.intent: Parse syslog-style timestamps into a monotonic integer and reconstruct the original format with exact spacing.
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    month, sp1, day, sp2, time = groups
    text = month + ' ' + day + ' ' + time
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%b %d %H:%M:%S')
    packed = (dt.month - 1) * 86400 + dt.day * 86400 + dt.hour * 3600 + dt.minute * 60 + dt.second
    return {'stored': [packed], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(sp2), len(day)]}

def inverse(record):
    packed = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len, sp2_len, day_width = layout
    month = (packed // 86400) + 1
    day = str((packed % 86400) // 86400).zfill(day_width)
    hours = (packed % 86400) // 3600
    minutes = (packed % 3600) // 60
    seconds = packed % 60
    dt = datetime(1900, month, int(day), hours, minutes, seconds)  # No year provided
    return dt.strftime('%b') + (' ' * sp1_len) + day + (' ' * sp2_len) + dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
